_comment: State for the hourly Drive image check.
Each entry records the Google Drive file id that produced the assets
currently committed under public/assets/images/bt/photos, so a re-upload is
detectable: Drive gives a replaced file a NEW id. If the id for a name
differs from the one here, the image was replaced and needs reprocessing; a
name absent here is a new image.
Names are matched case- and space-insensitively. The same two images have
`driveName` records what the folder last called each one.
Pipeline for every photograph: crop to the aspect its slot renders at,
resample in halving steps (one draw from 2000px lands soft), export WebP at
quality 0.90 - 0.82 for the page-header backdrops, which sit under an 82%
navy scrim - at 1x and 2x of the rendered CSS size, capping width at the
source so nothing is upscaled. Never ship the Drive original: they run 2-10
